#Approach
For this assignment, I had CoPilot (an LLM) generate a time-series dataset of synthetic data. It covers the years 2022 - 2026, tracking the sales performance of 8 grocery items. I will use window functions to calculate the Year-to-Date Average and also the 6-day moving average. 

Steps: Use dplyr for the window function, load in my file, Enforce formatting for the date column. I will use a window function for the item and date. I will also use a window function for the Year-To-Date average. 

Some potential challenges: Managing the dates/time: because this is a multi-year dataset, I need to ensure data completenes, especially for the window functions.
